The Nav SDK supports two types of trips: active guidance trips and free-drive trips. An active guidance trip is a navigation session that has turn-by-turn instructions to a specific destination. A free-drive trip is a navigation session that does not have turn by turn instructions to a specific destination, but still map-matches the user to a specific location and shows relevant information along their route.
Active guidance trips will appear on your invoice as Active Guidance Trips for Mobile and free-drive trips will appear as Free Drive Trips for Mobile.

Mapbox GL JS is a JavaScript library for vector maps on the Web. Its performance, real-time styling, and interactivity features set the bar for anyone building fast, immersive maps on the web. A map load occurs whenever a Map object is initialized, offering users unlimited interactivity with your web map.
A map load is counted every time Mapbox GL JS initializes on a webpage or in a web app. A map load includes unlimited Vector Tiles API and Raster Tiles API requests.

Mapbox Boundaries tilesets provide comprehensive data for boundary geometries and accompanying metadata, expertly curated across every country to support data visualization and geospatial analysis. Access is provided via a Mapbox Boundaries license (refer to the Boundaries FAQ
). National boundaries are available to all Mapbox users without a license as the Mapbox Countries v1 tileset

Mapbox Traffic Data is a dataset of estimated road speeds. Traffic Data includes Typical speeds, which are the expected traffic conditions throughout the week, and =Live speeds, which are speeds that have been directly observed in the last 15 minutes. Access is provided via a Mapbox Traffic Data license.

Mapbox Movement is a global privacy-forward dataset of de-identified and aggregated mobile device activity. The dataset captures significant driving and non-driving mobile device activity aggregated into geographic tiles of 100-meter resolution (approximately one city block) and select Mapbox boundaries. Access is provided via a Mapbox Movement Data license.

Commercial Application License for vehicle, B2B, and internal business applications

A Commercial Application License is required for production use (i.e., use in the course of any business operation, process, or analysis) of Mapbox services related to business intelligence or analytics, sales performance management, cloud database management systems, or real estate.

A Commercial Application License is also required for non-production and/or production use of Mapbox services for vehicle usage (including ground, aerial, manned and unmanned vehicles) including applications primarily intended for use within vehicles or use in any vehicle system or component thereof (whether installed in a vehicle during manufacture or thereafter).

A Commercial Application License provides clear commercial terms and predictable pricing. A Commercial Application License consists of an annual subscription and, where applicable, a per-user or seat-based component.

Customers may not use any Licensed Map Content in any printed or video media except expressly as set forth in the Mapbox Product Terms. Customers may purchase additional print or video rights for printed or video media by contacting Mapbox Sales.
